invariants.title: Public documented commands route to implemented CLI handlers
invariants.property: Every public Core command mentioned in README and onboarding docs must route to an implemented CLI command.
invariants.threshold: 0 missing command routes and 0 unqualified strong control claims

invariants.title: Capability states match shipped CLI behavior
invariants.property: Shipped capabilities must cite routed commands and evidence; planned capabilities must not be described as shipped.

invariants.title: Required validation suites are declared
invariants.property: The repository must declare required targeted, regression, and invariant validation suites.
